back: The minimum profit required to keep the entrepreneur in the current line of production in the long run; the opportunity cost of enterprise, included in cost.
Profit above normal profit: total revenue exceeds total economic cost (AR > ATC).
Shut down if price is below average variable cost; continue if price covers AVC even if below ATC.
Leave the industry if price is below average total cost (normal profit not covered).
Profit below normal: AR below ATC. The firm earns less than needed to stay in the long run.

front: Why continue producing at a loss in the short run?
back: If price covers AVC, the contribution to fixed cost makes the loss smaller than the fixed cost lost by closing.

front: Accounting profit US\$15,000; owner's next best income US\$12,000: economic profit?

back: Profit maximisation chooses the best output (MC = MR); cost minimisation finds the cheapest way to produce a given output.
